tested_features.details: Strict certificate chain and hostname verification.
Approved domains list enforces strict DNS resolution to official BLS host.
Loopback (127.0.0.1) and private RFC 1918 IPs raise SSRFProtectionError.
allow_redirects=False strictly enforced; cross-origin redirects rejected.
Max response size limited to 2 MB (2,097,152 bytes); oversized payload aborted.
network_enabled=False in offline development; zero requests dispatched.
